title: Derived normalization of the already constructed strict tensor map
statement: Let P,Q and their total tensor be good flat-term K-flat integral complexes. For the unique strict chain map tensorReductionStrictMap of [lem-coef-tensor-reduction-strict-assembly], its localization satisfies the whole-system representative square for reductionTensor from [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], with the adjunction-normalized reduction models and K-flat tensor comparisons of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations]. Explicitly, reduction of the integral tensor-model comparison followed by reductionTensor and the tensor of the two ordinary reduction-model maps equals the ordinary reduction-model map of the total tensor followed by the localization of tensorReductionStrictMap and the coherent tensor-model map. This asserts equality in the system derived category before evaluation or any limit; it makes no chain-map existence or finite-component assertion.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 07A6 and 0941; steps 1 and 2 of lem-coef-tensor-reduction-ordinary-model

proof.text: The canonical representative-square transport supplies an existential chain map ψ with the whole-system square and its finite component characterization.

The strict assembly uniqueness theorem identifies ψ with tensorReductionStrictMap from the shared finite-component characterization. Substitution in the transported whole-system square gives the displayed equality.

theorem tensorReductionStrictMap_derived_square (W : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory)
    (hT : integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W
      ((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W)).obj (P.obj, Q.obj))) :
    let S := pullbackTensorCalculus l E W
    let T := (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W)).obj (P.obj, Q.obj)
    S.reduction.map ((S.integralTensorModel.iso (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W) S.integralClosed
        P.obj Q.obj P.property.1 Q.property.1).hom) ≫
      S.reductionTensor.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj) ≫
      S.systemClosed.tensor.map
        (Prod.mkHom ((pullbackTensorReductionModel l E W).hom.app P)
          ((pullbackTensorReductionModel l E W).hom.app Q)) =
    (pullbackTensorReductionModel l E W).hom.app ⟨T, hT⟩ ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (tensorReductionStrictMap l E W P.obj Q.obj) ≫
      (pullbackTensorSystemModel l E W _ _
        (pullbackTensorReductionGood l E W P)
        (pullbackTensorReductionGood l E W Q)).hom
